props.name: value
props.description: The open item's value; `null` for closed. Leave it out to let the menu keep its own.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called once per change, including when the browser closed the content (Escape, a press outside).

props.name: delay
props.description: How long the pointer rests on a trigger before its content opens, in ms.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long after the pointer leaves before the content closes, in ms.

props.name: value
props.description: Identifies the item; the root's `value` names the open one.

parts.name: NavigationMenuTrigger
parts.description: Opens its item's content: on hover after the root's delay (at once while another item is open), on click, and with ArrowDown (ArrowRight in a vertical menu), which also moves focus into it. Spread it on a <button>: its `popovertarget` keeps a press on it from counting as a press outside the content, and its click is prevented so the browser doesn't toggle the content itself.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present on the trigger while its popup is open.

parts.name: NavigationMenuIcon
parts.description: Shows whether its item is open (a chevron, say), with `data-popup-open`. Hidden from assistive technology.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present on the trigger while its popup is open.

parts.name: NavigationMenuContent
parts.description: The item's panel: declare it after the item's trigger. `data-activation-direction` says where the previously open item was ("left" or "right"; "up" or "down" when vertical) while it is open.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger it sits on; the browser flips it when it doesn't fit.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger it lines up with.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between trigger and content, in pixels.

dataAttributes.name: data-activation-direction
dataAttributes.description: The direction of the newly active item relative to the previous one.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of its anchor the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.

props.name: active
props.description: Whether the link is the current page: `aria-current="page"` and `data-active`.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether following the link closes the content.

parts.name: NavigationMenuArrow
parts.description: Spread on an element inside the popup: it is placed on the popup's edge that faces the trigger, centred on the trigger, and carries the popup's `data-side`. The shape (a rotated square, an SVG) is the stylesheet's.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of its anchor the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.
